title: Wedding Coin, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description The Wedding Coin is an elegant keepsake created for a wedding occasion. The bride and groom motif highlights the meaning of a shared beginning, while floral details add lightness and a refined tone. It is a gift that fits the day of the ceremony and stays with the couple for years, as a symbol of an important date and lasting memories.
